research_mission: Comprehensive Maryland boating, crabbing, camping, hiking, and monetization research
summary: Extensive web research covering Maryland DNR regulations, outdoor recreation infrastructure, guide services, and affiliate opportunities to support app development for fishing, crabbing, camping, and hiking phases

key_findings.crabbing: Recreational season April 1 - December 15, males only 5+ inches, daily limits vary by boat license status (2-6 dozen male crabs), crab pots require turtle reduction devices
key_findings.boating: Boating license required (born after July 1, 1972), vessel registration 2-year validity, at least 1 PFD per person, PWC operators 16+ with license
key_findings.camping: Maryland state parks via parkreservations.maryland.gov (365-day advance), Green Ridge 100 primitive sites ($10/night), 45+ private campgrounds including glamping options
key_findings.hiking: 40 miles AT in Maryland, 6 major shelters, Catoctin Mountain Park trails, Billy Goat Trail challenging scramble, Sugarloaf Mountain quartzite views, Four States Challenge 45 miles in 24 hours
key_findings.monetization: Amazon Associates active (mdoutdoors-20), Campnab $3-7 per referral potential, 10+ fishing guides, 9+ hunting outfitters, guide service booking partnerships available
